candidates.title: Celebrating Yalda Night
candidates.description: Join us for a special Yalda Night celebration with children’s author Anahita Tamaddon and a reading of her book, Yalda Night ! Experience the beauty of this cherished Persian tradition through a Yalda-inspired story, music, and a fun paper craft featuring one of Yalda’s beloved symbols. Yalda, the longest night of the year, is a joyful celebration of family, storytelling, and togetherness as we welcome the arrival of winter. All craft materials will be provided.
